newsitem.title: USA: Republic to buy Snappy Car for $26 million.
newsitem.headline: Republic to buy Snappy Car for $26 million.

text.p: Republic Industries Inc. said Tuesday it agreed to acquire Snappy Car Rental Inc. of Tulsa, Okla. for $26 million in cash or stock, at Republic's discretion.

Snappy Car Rental, owned primarily by an investor group led by Jacobson Partners, a New York-based investment firm, is active in the insurance replacement car rental industry. It provides rental cars for drivers whose vehicles are being repaired or replaced.
Republic said Snappy will join its other insurance replacement car rental companies, Spirit Rent-A-Car and the Alasys division of Alamo Rent-A-Car.
Snappy has 220 branch locations in 38 states and a fleet of approximately 14,500 vehicles.

Republic Industries, based in Fort Lauderdale, Fla., is a holding company with subsidiaries in the automotive retailing, automotive rental, automotive financial services, solid waste services and electronic security services industries.
